Terms of service

Nyuchi workspace tools · last updated 14 August 2026

Who these cover

These terms cover tools.nyuchi.com and the tools hosted on it — the signature generator, the Gmail add-on, Nyuchi Studio, the MCP server, and the Meeting load Google Calendar add-on — operated by Nyuchi Africa (Pvt) Ltd (“we”). Using any of them means accepting these terms.

Who may use them

The signature and brand tools are provided for Nyuchi Africa (Pvt) Ltd staff and the Bundu ecosystem brands, and most of the site requires a Nyuchi sign-in. Meeting load is open source and available to anyone. Do not use any of these tools if you are under 13.

Acceptable use

  • Do not use the tools to impersonate a person or an organisation you are not authorised to represent.
  • Do not attempt to access accounts, calendars, or mailboxes other than those you are authorised to administer.
  • Do not probe, overload, or interfere with the service or the infrastructure behind it.
  • Do not use the generated assets to misrepresent an affiliation with the Bundu brands.

Your content

You keep ownership of what you put in — your signature details, your calendar data, and the brand assets you generate. You grant us only the access needed to perform the action you asked for. What we do and do not do with it is set out in theprivacy policy.

Google Workspace

Where a tool acts on your Google account it does so under scopes you explicitly grant, and you can revoke that access at any time from yourGoogle account permissions. Revoking access stops the tool working; it does not delete anything already applied to your account.

Open source

Meeting load and these workspace tools are published under the MIT licence, which governs your use of the source code and includes its own warranty disclaimer. Running your own copy is explicitly allowed and is your own responsibility to operate.

Availability

These are internal tools offered as-is, with no uptime commitment and no service-level agreement. We may change, suspend, or withdraw any of them, and we may change these terms — the revised date above tells you when that last happened.

No warranty, and limits

The tools are provided without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose. Meeting load's figures are a summary of your calendar and are not a timekeeping, payroll, or billing record; do not rely on them as one. To the fullest extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of these tools.

Governing law
